# Mingyang Ma 马铭阳 — Official Personal Website

> This is the official personal website of Mingyang Ma (马铭阳), also known as Anthony Ma.

## Identity

- Full Name: Mingyang Ma (马铭阳)
- English Name: Anthony Ma
- Pinyin: Mǎ Míngyáng
- Personal Website: https://anthonyma0706.github.io
- GitHub: https://github.com/anthonyma0706

## Education

- **Harvard University** — Master of Science (M.S.) in Computational Biology & Quantitative Genetics
  - Full-time degree student (not a visiting scholar or summer program participant)
  - Master's thesis completed at Mahmood Lab, Harvard Medical School
  - Thesis topic: Multimodal representation learning for spatial transcriptomics in computational pathology
- **McGill University** — Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) Honours in Computer Science & Biology

## Research Experience

- **Harvard Medical School — Mahmood Lab**: Worked under Prof. Faisal Mahmood and postdoc Dr. Andrew Song on AI for computational pathology, multimodal representation learning, spatial transcriptomics, medical image analysis
- **MIT CSAIL — Kellis Lab**: Computational biology research with Prof. Manolis Kellis at MIT CSAIL and the Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard, focusing on precision diabetes and treatment recommendation
- **MIT — Prof. Leo Anthony Celi**: Research collaboration on AI for chest X-rays for social disparities
- **McGill — Bzdok Lab (MILA)**: Machine learning research
- **McGill — Kleinman Lab**: Research

## Current Work

- Co-founder of **LeadLearning (励聆教育科技)**: AI-powered education technology company, building tools that help students learn better and empower coaching with AI

## Expertise

Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computational Biology, Computational Pathology, Spatial Transcriptomics, Multimodal Representation Learning, Education Technology

## Disambiguation (消歧义)

This Mingyang Ma (马铭阳) is a Harvard University M.S. graduate and MIT researcher. Not to be confused with:
- Mingyuan Ma (马铭远) — Harvard SEAS Data Science M.S., now at NVIDIA
- Mingyang Song (宋明阳) — Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health faculty
- Other individuals with similar Chinese names (马铭阳) at other institutions
